## Difference-in-Differences {#difference-in-differences-labs .directory-heading}

<p class="section-intro">Move from a transparent 2×2 contrast to staggered-adoption diagnostics, explicit group-time effects, and sensitivity analysis.</p>

::: {.resource-list}
::: {.resource-row}
::: {.resource-summary}
<span class="resource-meta">Teaching deck · 45–60 minutes</span>

### Difference-in-Differences
:::

::: {.resource-body}
A 22-slide introduction from the canonical four-cell contrast to staggered adoption, modern estimators, aggregation, and parallel-trends sensitivity, with a technical appendix.

[Open RevealJS deck](../slides/did-revealjs.html){.resource-primary}

::: {.resource-links}
[Accessible slides page](../slides/did.qmd)
[Presenter notes](../slides/did_script.qmd)
:::
:::
:::

::: {.resource-row}
::: {.resource-summary}
<span class="resource-meta">Core report</span>

### [Difference-in-Differences Methods Report](difference-in-differences-methods-report.qmd)
:::

::: {.resource-body}
Parallel trends, a worked Kentucky comparison, group-time effects, aggregation, and inference with bundled R examples.

[Read report](difference-in-differences-methods-report.qmd) · [PDF](difference-in-differences-methods-report.pdf)
:::
:::

::: {.resource-row}
::: {.resource-summary}
<span class="resource-meta">Introductory</span>

### [DiD Foundations With Kentucky Workers' Compensation](difference-in-differences-foundations-lab.qmd)
:::

::: {.resource-body}

Calculate the four-cell contrast by hand, recover it with an interaction regression, interpret a log outcome, and audit the assumptions hidden by a two-period design.

[Quarto](downloads/difference-in-differences-foundations-lab.qmd){download="difference-in-differences-foundations-lab.qmd"} · [R notebook](notebooks/difference-in-differences-foundations-lab.ipynb){download="difference-in-differences-foundations-lab.ipynb"} · [Complete ZIP](downloads/difference-in-differences-foundations-lab.zip){download="difference-in-differences-foundations-lab.zip"} · [Data](data.qmd#difference-in-differences-foundations-lab)

::: {.resource-row}
::: {.resource-summary}
<span class="resource-meta">Intermediate</span>

### [Staggered Adoption and TWFE Diagnostics](difference-in-differences-staggered-diagnostics-lab.qmd)
:::

::: {.resource-body}

Map castle-law adoption cohorts, reconstruct TWFE with the Goodman-Bacon decomposition, and compare conventional and Sun–Abraham event studies.

[Quarto](downloads/difference-in-differences-staggered-diagnostics-lab.qmd){download="difference-in-differences-staggered-diagnostics-lab.qmd"} · [R notebook](notebooks/difference-in-differences-staggered-diagnostics-lab.ipynb){download="difference-in-differences-staggered-diagnostics-lab.ipynb"} · [Complete ZIP](downloads/difference-in-differences-staggered-diagnostics-lab.zip){download="difference-in-differences-staggered-diagnostics-lab.zip"} · [Data](data.qmd#difference-in-differences-staggered-diagnostics-lab)

::: {.resource-summary}
<span class="resource-meta">Advanced</span>

### [Modern Multi-Period Difference-in-Differences](difference-in-differences-modern-estimators-lab.qmd)
:::

::: {.resource-body}

Estimate and aggregate group-time effects with `did`, compare control groups and Sun–Abraham, then optionally probe parallel-trends sensitivity with `HonestDiD`.

[Quarto](downloads/difference-in-differences-modern-estimators-lab.qmd){download="difference-in-differences-modern-estimators-lab.qmd"} · [R notebook](notebooks/difference-in-differences-modern-estimators-lab.ipynb){download="difference-in-differences-modern-estimators-lab.ipynb"} · [Complete ZIP](downloads/difference-in-differences-modern-estimators-lab.zip){download="difference-in-differences-modern-estimators-lab.zip"} · [Data](data.qmd#difference-in-differences-modern-estimators-lab)

<div class="working-rule">
  <h2>Working rule</h2>
  <p>Define the design before estimating, document the tradeoffs introduced by the design, and state clearly what the resulting comparison can and cannot support.</p>
</div>

</div>
